an8.40:1.1: (1) “Bhikkhus, the destruction of life, repeatedly pursued, developed, and cultivated, is conducive to hell, to the animal realm, and to the sphere of afflicted spirits;
an8.40:1.2: for one reborn as a human being the destruction of life at minimum conduces to a short life span.
an8.40:2.1: (2) “Taking what is not given, repeatedly pursued, developed, and cultivated, is conducive to hell, to the animal realm, and to the sphere of afflicted spirits;
an8.40:2.2: for one reborn as a human being taking what is not given at minimum conduces to loss of wealth.
an8.40:3.1: (3) “Sexual misconduct, repeatedly pursued, developed, and cultivated, is conducive to hell, to the animal realm, and to the sphere of afflicted spirits;
an8.40:3.2: for one reborn as a human being sexual misconduct at minimum conduces to enmity and rivalry.
an8.40:4.1: (4) “False speech, repeatedly pursued, developed, and cultivated, is conducive to hell, to the animal realm, and to the sphere of afflicted spirits;
an8.40:4.2: for one reborn as a human being false speech at minimum conduces to false accusations.
an8.40:5.1: (5) “Divisive speech, repeatedly pursued, developed, and cultivated, is conducive to hell, to the animal realm, and to the sphere of afflicted spirits;
an8.40:5.2: for one reborn as a human being divisive speech at minimum conduces to being divided from one’s friends.
an8.40:6.1: (6) “Harsh speech, repeatedly pursued, developed, and cultivated, is conducive to hell, to the animal realm, and to the sphere of afflicted spirits;
an8.40:6.2: for one reborn as a human being harsh speech at minimum conduces to disagreeable sounds.
an8.40:7.1: (7) “Idle chatter, repeatedly pursued, developed, and cultivated, is conducive to hell, to the animal realm, and to the sphere of afflicted spirits;
an8.40:7.2: for one reborn as a human being idle chatter at minimum conduces to others distrusting one’s words.
an8.40:8.1: (8) “Drinking liquor and wine, repeatedly pursued, developed, and cultivated, is conducive to hell, to the animal realm, and to the sphere of afflicted spirits;
an8.40:8.2: for one reborn as a human being drinking liquor and wine at minimum conduces to madness.”
